notes: Coverage. All 93 files of the area were searched with several patterns: getenv, setenv, putenv, environ, envp, Rust std::env calls, env! and option_env!, popen and exec calls, locale and time zone calls, shell-style $NAME text, and every upper-case name with a TRON prefix. Every hit was read in context. Read in full: src/runtron.cpp, src/rinzler_host_main.cpp, h/rinzler/rinzler-config.hpp, h/runtron/trace_lifecycle.hpp. src/rinzler.cpp was read line by line for lines 1-200, 280-316, 1700-2555 and 4040-5209 (globals, model loading, the controller constructor, argument parsing and main). The request handlers in between were covered by the pattern search only. The other files were covered by the pattern search and by reading around each hit. No file was skipped. Structure of the list. Entries 1 to 13 are names that files of this area read or set directly, plus TIKTOKEN_ENCODINGS_BASE, which a third-party library reads when the Rust crate of this area calls it. The other entries are names read by helper functions outside this area that rinzler or runtron call during startup or per request. For those, the first reader is the real getenv site and the later readers are the call sites in this area. Their notes name the owning area, whose text for values, default and effect should win in a merge. Programs. src/rinzler.cpp is compiled into four programs: rinzler, rinzler_mock, rinzler_host and rinzler_proxy (src/CMakeLists.txt:95, 115, 152, 180). rinzler_proxy defines RINZLER_NO_FUSE_MOUNT and never mounts FUSE. rinzler_mock, rinzler_host and rinzler_proxy link the fake device library (pos_fake), where get_devices() is a stub and pos_heap_setup is never called. The files under src/rinzler/ form the static library librinzler, which runtron also links. Not listed as entries. (1) Variables read deeper inside the tron and device libraries, which rinzler and runtron reach through get_scheduler (src/rinzler.cpp:2113, h/runtron/stream_generate.hpp:971) and model loading. Examples: TRON_BOOK_INITIAL_TOKENS, TRON_BOOK_MAX_TOKENS, TRON_DEFRAG_BOOKS_DEPTH, TRON_PER_USER_PROMPT_CHUNK_LIMIT, USE_HW_ATTN, TRON_HW_SAMPLER. These call chains were not traced here. (2) TIKTOKEN_RS_CACHE_DIR, which the openai-harmony library reads; no file in the checkout names it. (3) LC_TIME, which appears only in comments of rust/minijinja/src/lib.rs. (4) VLLM_SYSTEM_START_DATE, which appears only in comments as the vLLM name that RZ_SYSTEM_START_DATE mirrors. (5) USE_HW_ATTN through hw_attn_engagement_point at h/runtron/stream_generate.hpp:863: that code is inside #ifdef LOG_TOKEN_SELECTION, and the define at line 48 is commented out. Findings for the document. (a) POS_WEIGHTS_DIR changes the weights root for models given by name, but --model-path in rinzler and a relative --model-path in runtron use the fixed prefix /opt/positron/weights/huggingface/. (b) RZ_KV_CACHE_GB is ignored with a warning when the arena allocator is active, and the arena allocator is the build default. (c) USE_PYTHON_TOKENIZER and VALIDATE_TOKENIZERS treat every value except the exact text false as on, so the value 0 turns them on. (d) TRON_TRACE_CATEGORIES is read through a constant name and is missing from the baseline scan. (e) An invalid RZ_KV_CACHE_GB value is not caught: std::stoull throws out of main. No name in this area is built at run time, so dynamic_sites is empty. The only set operation in this area is TZ for a child test process (rust/minijinja/src/lib.rs:908).
